name: GameVerse
description: Gameplay clip metadata and paired camera-pose and temporally grounded caption annotations for 69,678 retained clips. The release provides source URLs and clip boundaries but does not redistribute MP4 videos.

rai:dataCollection: GameVerse was curated from source YouTube gameplay recordings. The recorded scenes are rendered by game engines during play, not generated by a text-to-video model. Videos were segmented into scenes, filtered, and refined into clips of up to two minutes. The CSV retains source URLs and clip boundaries; source MP4 files are not redistributed.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: Source gameplay recordings are identified by YouTube URLs in the CSV. A source-video URL list is also available at https://github.com/kangverse/GameVerse/blob/main/gameverse_url.txt.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Scene segmentation, clip selection, fine-grained filtering, and post-acceptance quality control produced the final 69,678-clip selection.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The release pairs each clip with camera-pose and structured caption annotations. Captions include clip-level descriptions and segment-level time ranges; pose records are estimated camera trajectories. Some two-minute clips have incomplete temporal caption coverage, and re-annotation is in progress.
rai:machineAnnotationTools: Camera trajectories were estimated with the ViPE pose pipeline. Structured captions were produced through a model-assisted annotation pipeline.
rai:dataLimitations: Source YouTube recordings may become unavailable or change; exact video reconstruction requires the corresponding source media and timing metadata.

Some two-minute clips have caption segments that do not cover the full clip. The final selection has five clips without a corresponding pose file; pose-to-video temporal alignment should be checked for a specific use.
Game-rendered footage is not evidence of real-world physical dynamics or human behavior.
rai:dataBiases: Selection from available YouTube gameplay and subsequent quality filtering may overrepresent games, visual styles, and recording practices that are easier to collect or pass the filters; representativeness across games and players has not been established.
Model-assisted captions may contain annotation errors or model-specific descriptive biases; these have not been quantified for every clip.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The CSV contains source YouTube URLs and video IDs, which can be linked to uploader accounts. Linked recordings or free-text captions may contain player handles, voices, or other identifying content; the release has not been certified free of personal information.
rai:dataUseCases: Intended for non-commercial research on long-horizon interactive world modeling, camera-conditioned video learning, and temporally grounded gameplay description, subject to the dataset license.
Not validated for real-world navigation, safety-critical decisions, or inference about player demographics or behavior.
rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset may support research on interactive video models and temporal understanding. Users should consider the rights and context of linked source recordings and the possibility that selection or annotation biases transfer into trained systems. The release redistributes metadata and annotations rather than source MP4 files.
